name: Intelligent Hotel Group Ltd
summary: Intelligent Hotel Group Ltd currently possesses no substantial ongoing business activities. In the past, the company's operations included the commerce of bio-carbon-based fertilizers (BCBF), e-commerce ventures, and the distribution of beauty items. At present, it is actively identifying potential acquisition targets and exploring strategic business prospects, with an aim to establish itself in diverse industries such as hospitality, cinema, renewable energy, and the automotive sector. This entity, which was originally incorporated in 2019, operates from its base in Chongqing, People's Republic of China, and adopted its current name, Intelligent Hotel Group Ltd, in May 2025, having previously been known as YCQH Agricultural Technology Co. Ltd.
